$comment: Declarative Android emulator device matrix for realistic mobile app testing on tori (192.168.0.20). One profile runs at a time (host RAM constraint: 4 vCPU / ~7.7 GiB); the persistent agent_feedback AVD is separate and stays resident. AVDs are created once via avdmanager and managed by scripts/emulator-matrix.sh.

profiles.label: Small phone / 16:9
profiles.rationale: Compact legacy-class 16:9 handset; smallest common denominator for layout overflow and bottom-sheet/scroll behavior.

profiles.label: Modern tall phone
profiles.rationale: Current mainstream tall aspect ratio; representative of most real devices Ben's users carry.

profiles.label: Large phone
profiles.rationale: High-density QHD+ phablet; stresses high-resolution asset scaling and gesture-nav layout.

profiles.label: Tablet / foldable-class
profiles.rationale: Wide landscape tablet-class surface; approximates unfolded foldable inner display for multi-pane layouts.
